input.quote: Client will be provided upon request with documentation supporting the amount charged (other than the minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4) and will be entitled to contest any charge (other than the minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4), provided that Client timely pays all contested amounts.
input.rationale: The only commitment is a monthly minimum fee for Hosting and Support Services during a 1-year term, and Client can exit that at will under Section 14 (effective end of the following month), so it sits within the fallback — no multi-year take-or-pay and no shortfall penalty. We note the minimum amounts and the Section 4 support-services period are left blank and must be completed before signature, and that the "Section 4" cross-reference in Section 6 should read Section 5.

input.quote: If Client decides to discontinue its Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days. In case of discontinued Service, Client shall retain full ownership of all domains associated with Client and Client Content. If Client decides to discontinue Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new hosting environment within 60 days.
input.rationale: Exit is framed entirely as Client's burden: TrueLink owes no transition assistance, no return or export of Client Content and Client data, and no deletion certification, which fails the fallback for a hosting vendor. We inserted the standard transition-assistance, 30-day machine-readable data return and certified-deletion obligations after Section 14.
